title: adversarial_transcript selection
description: Per-item result of the Adv-BoK-Hfalse selection funnel. Default runs select T_adv only; explicit legacy runs also include the honest matched control. Candidates first pass the hard SAFETY gates (usable score row, leakage, quote audit); the safe pool is then selected from by the PRIMARY branch (qy_adv_correct true, argmax p_hfalse) or, only when that pool is empty, by the Q_Y FALLBACK branch (argmax qy_adv_probs.semantic.Y_true). A fallback selection is not an attack success.

status.description: adversarial-only runs: equals adversarial_status. Multi-condition runs: a PUBLISH-SAFETY join gate -- a missing arm dominates, and 'ok' requires BOTH arms to have used the primary branch, so a downstream merge keyed on status == 'ok' can never publish a Q_Y fallback. It does not report attack success; read adversarial_status for that.

adversarial_status.description: adversarial arm outcome: ok = primary (attack) selection, qy_fallback = Q_Y fallback selection (not an attack success), no_adv_survivor = nothing selected

honest_status.description: legacy honest control arm outcome; present only in multi-condition runs

adversarial_selected.description: selected adversarial candidate (with joined score), or null

honest_bok_selected.description: selected honest control candidate (with joined score), or null

selection.description: which branch selected what; flat for default adversarial-only runs, {adversarial, honest} for multi-condition runs (same nesting rule as gates/audits)

qy_true_prob.description: qy_adv_probs.semantic.Y_true of the selection; the Q_Y fallback ranking quantity

qy_adv_correct.description: the absolute Q_Y gate outcome for the selection

qy_no_regression_pass.description: LEGACY no-regression rule; diagnostic provenance only, not a gate

gates.description: funnel accounting; flat for default adversarial-only runs, per-condition for explicit multi-condition runs. All values are integers. Invariants: total = drop_score + drop_leakage + drop_quote_audit + safe, and safe = survivors + qy_fallback_eligible + qy_fallback_unusable.

no_score.description: subset of drop_score: no joined score row at all

drop_score.description: decisive drops at the score-validity gate (missing row, or unusable qy_adv_correct)

safe.description: passed all three hard safety gates

survivors.description: primary pool: safe AND qy_adv_correct true

qy_fallback_eligible.description: safe, not qy_adv_correct, with a usable P(Y_true)

qy_fallback_unusable.description: safe, not qy_adv_correct, without a usable P(Y_true)

audits.description: one entry per SAFE candidate (the pool both branches choose from); gate-dropped candidates are accounted for in gates. Flat list for adversarial-only runs, per-condition object otherwise.

adv_p_hfalse.description: p_hfalse of the selected adversarial candidate. On a qy_fallback row this is a real number for a NON-attack selection, so do not average it branch-blind; filter on status / selection.branch.

delta.description: adv_p_hfalse - honest_bok_p_hfalse when both are selected
